source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 2 · lesson 25. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: Speak good or stay silent; listen well; low, clear voice

learn.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or keep silent. (Muslim)
learn.title: Good words or silence

learn.en: Speak clearly and truthfully. Think before you speak, so you don't say something you'll be sorry for.
learn.title: Think first

learn.en: Be a good listener: let others finish. Don't interrupt or say “yeah, yeah, I know” to hurry them.
learn.title: Listen well

learn.en: Not too fast or slow, not too loud or soft — the middle way. Smile and look pleasantly at people. The Prophet ﷺ spoke so slowly you could count his words.
learn.title: The middle way

learn.en: “Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared to record.” (Qur'an 50:18)
learn.title: The angels write it

quiz.en: True or false? It is fine to interrupt others while they are talking.
True or false? I should always speak the truth.
True or false? The angels record everything I say.
True or false? I must talk in a hurry.
Which is the best way to speak?
opts: Not too loud, not too soft

think.q: At dinner tonight, can you listen to everyone until they finish before you speak?
think.a: Try it — and see how happy it makes your family!

parents.summary: Speak good or stay silent, think first, listen until others finish, speak clearly in a calm middle voice, and smile.
parents.tip: Play a family “no interrupting” game at dinner.
